record.question: Which of the following groups is a Shia militant group?
record.explanation: The contemporaneous 2012 NCTC profile explicitly identifies Hizballah/Hezbollah as a Lebanon-based Shia group. It is the uniquely Shia organization in this option set; no current organization status is asserted. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.dni.gov/files/documents/2012_nctc_ct_calendar.pdf Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
